propositions: On Data Center, outbound status mutations are submitted as field edits via issue.update(fields=...) instead of being routed to transition_issue_by_name, causing Jira to reject the status as a non-editable field and the issue status to remain unchanged

The Cloud transport (acli.py) pops status from kwargs and routes it to transition_issue_by_name, but the Data Center transport (transport.py) does not perform this routing, creating asymmetry between backends

JiraDataCenterTransport.update_issue must pop status from kwargs, resolve it to a transition via the transition resolver, and dispatch that transition instead of including status in the field-edit payload
Illegal transitions from the current workflow state must remain non-fatal and observable as bridge_alerts records rather than silently failing or propagating as HTTPError
Live test test_outbound_mutation_round_trips[04-transition-status] fails on real DC instances with 'fields.status.name is To Do' when attempting an open->in_progress transition
